source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. Printed header: Half Yearly Examination 2018-2019, Chemistry, Class : VIII, Time : 2 hrs. + 15 Mins., Full Marks : 80; examYear 2019 is the later year of the printed session. Each PDF page is a two-page booklet spread: PDF page 1 = printed pages 6 and 1, PDF page 2 = printed pages 2 and 5, PDF page 3 = printed page 3 shown twice, PDF page 4 = printed page 4 shown twice; all six printed pages are present. Section A [40 Marks] is compulsory; Section B [40 Marks] has six questions (Questions 2-7) of 10 marks each of which any four are to be attempted, so the listed marks add up to 100, not 80. Chemical subscripts and superscripts are written with Unicode characters as read from the page image. The paper's own spellings (e.g. 'Radiu', 'diulute', 'Element/Iron') are kept. No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
